name: Bear, Brown
printing: Monster Vault (2024), verified through the 2025 Nosolorol Spanish edition
translationLicense: Licensed Spanish edition of Kobold Press’s 2024 Monster Vault
sourceWitness: Read the stat block and challenge roster in a local copy of Nosolorol’s published Spanish . The official English catalog independently confirms the indexed name, size, type, CR and habitats.
xpEvidence: Cubil de Monstruos p. 373 (p. 375) lists 200 XP for CR 1.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the selected portrait at beast-ready-batch-04/parts/b04_02/portraits/brown-bear.png.
habitatEvidence: Official English Monster Vault catalog tags.
printingNotes: The Spanish block prints fixed HP and six ability modifiers.

Visually confirmed on the folio that Multiattack calls for one bite and one claw but phrases the grapple requirement as both claw attacks hitting. Kobold Press errata adds general escape procedure on p. 25 without revising either bear. The separate English Black Flag Reference Document gives a playable comparison requiring both listed attacks to hit the same creature.
The block starts at bottom left and continues at top right on the same folio.
